composition_subtypes.role: Sort items by price to enable grouping rule where most expensive is last
Compute max items with prefix DP tracking remaining coins

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort items by price, then apply DP over prefixes considering single and group purchases.
payload.rationale: Sorting arranges items by price so that in any group the most expensive is last; DP then optimally chooses single or group buys from the sorted list.
